title: Arcade Ladder
description: A web-based arcade platform where every game has a ladder and every player has a rank.

title: Doodle Market
description: Upload, sell, and rate doodles. Demonstrates backend concepts like ownership-based authorization, full purchase flow, transactional emails, audit logging, rate limiting, integration testing, and admin tooling.

title: Astro Starter
description: Production-ready Astro template built to rank with strong SEO foundations out of the box. Ships with a TypeScript-first architecture, SCSS design token system, structured data, and optimal Core Web Vitals.

title: Video Searcher
description: AI-powered video analysis tool that turns long-form video into searchable, timestamped moments. Users upload any video, enter a natural-language query, and the app returns the exact scenes that match.

title: GGList
description: Platform for voting and viewing top favorites for any collection. It demonstrates relational data modeling, Google OAuth authentication, Cloud SQL persistence, and data visualization.

title: Upload Center
description: GCP-native demonstrations of text sentiment analysis, image recognition, and JSONL/CSV data analysis.

title: Nerd by Day, Nerd by Night
description: Small e-commerce store built from scratch on Google Cloud Platform with Cloud SQL persistence. Integrations for Stripe payment processing and order management included.

title: Susie Jetta
description: Client site for a small business owner, designed, built, and deployed to production on GCP. Includes Cloud Build CI/CD, Cloud Storage for media assets, and a performant React frontend optimized for local SEO and mobile conversion.
